data: The caption states that the figure shows the change of the polarity-over-time (POT) score for "coronavirus," "lockdown," and "pandemic" early in 2020. The lines in the graph represent these terms. The red line corresponds to "S&P 500 Index," which is not relevant to the question. The blue dotted line represents "coronavirus," the yellow line represents "lockdown," and the cyan line represents "pandemic." Therefore, the cyan line represents the 'pandemic' score.
